header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: and (He sees) your movements among those who prostrate (in worship) (when you are with them). Surely He alone is the All-Hearing (of everything), the All-Knowing.
He is with you wherever you are.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمَنْ يَعْشُ عَنْ ذِكْرِالرَّحْمنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطاَناً فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Whoever turns away from the remembrance of the Most Gracious, We appoint for him a Shaytan; he becomes his close companion.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (فَلَوْ لَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمَُسَبِّحِينَ ۞ لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلي يَوِْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Had he not been among those who glorify (Us) inside the belly of the fish - he would certainly have remained in its belly until the day they are raised.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (فَسُبْحنَ اللهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: So (O believers,) keep glorifying Allah (in Salah) when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (يآيُّهَا الَّذِينَ امَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا ۞ وَّسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَّأَصِيلاً۞).
